hypothesis: A bounded native four-rank component probe can establish the missing BF16 ordering and exact checkpoint/evaluation identity gates before any Track B2 training candidate is authorized.
single_causal_change: No training or model change. The probe observes one predeclared dense-versus-touched native update and strict-loads one authenticated real 35c9 checkpoint through control and candidate model paths.

success_criteria.identity: Both exact pinned modules call load_state_dict(strict=True) on the same authenticated checkpoint; ordered keys, b1/t1/b5/t5 bytes, and logits for the fixed 1x1024 input are bit-exact.
success_criteria.bf16: Candidate export returns independently checked dense/touched parameter and logical-state tensors that are bit-exact, proves duplicates and four-rank AVG, and proves untouched parameter/physical-state bytes unchanged.
success_criteria.evidence: Runtime, Torch, torch-neuronx, Neuron compiler/runtime, host, LNC, world size, source identities, input hash, tensor hashes, and result are sealed in one non-overwriting receipt.

abort_conditions: Authorization is not fully bound to one successful authenticated exact-35c9 Track A receipt.
Checkpoint, receipt, control, candidate, core, request, host, or environment identity differs.
Candidate path equals control path or lacks the required probe export.
Any strict-load, ordered-key, table-byte, fixed-logit, duplicate, AVG, BF16 ordering, untouched-row, finite, or rank-consensus check fails.
Any training, checkpoint mutation, prune, cleanup, submission, network access, or source modification is attempted.
verdict: Harness preparation only. Training stays blocked after a component pass and requires a separate proposal, verification, and human approval.
